cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this fizzy Coward revival, with O'Hara and Byrne's drunken comic chemistry earning raves as the production's irresistible centerpiece, though some find the century-old material thin beneath the champagne bubbles.

vr.q: Lighthearted yet quality comedy is difficult to achieve, but it is done well here.
